content:
devon: heads-up: omega2b-int4 onboarding tomorrow. need a compact but high-signal promptset focused on code-mixed locales, numeric formatting, and structured inputs.
yasmin: agree. suggest fresh micro-golden ~650 and a review pool ~1350. keep ~120 stable anchors separate.
otto: we should include a small 'format-preserve' partition (200 items) that specifically checks JSON/markdown table preservation under quantization. those were flaky last cycle.
frida: for dedupe, propose exact_token_overlap=0.93 then semantic_cos>=0.82 using embed tok-v5. keep one canonical per semantic cluster but preserve variant intents.
labelops-bot: LabelOps capacity: 1.5k/day. recommend double-review for golden. Reserve slots?
devon: reserve slots. workflow: sample -> normalize (nfkc+lower+trim) -> exact dedupe -> semantic cluster prune -> triage -> mark synthetics -> double-label golden -> adjudicate. owner: yasmin.
yasmin: timeline: start 08:30 UTC, 72h window. escalation to devon if disagreement > 16%.
otto: also include 75 long sequences (>1400 tokens) to stress kv cache and boundary kernels. add 150 adversarial formatting prompts (malformed JSON, nested codeblocks).
frida: tokenizer-variant checks please: bpe vs unigram diffs and token-level diff exports. token-count alone missed subtle span shifts before.
eval-bot: suggested sampling config:
```
mode: compact_focus
locales: ["pt_BR","ko","ru","en-CA","es-AR"]
min_tokens: 15
max_tokens: 2000
exact_dedupe: 0.93
semantic_dedupe: 0.82
golden_count: 650
labelpool_count: 1350
adversarial_count: 150
long_seq_count: 75
embed_model: tok-v5-embed
normalization: nfkc+lower+trim_ws
exclude_lists: ["holdout_main_2025","omega_stable_anchors"]
```
yasmin: will stage normalized candidates to s3://curation/omega2b/compact-2025 and attach provenance.json.
labelops-bot: Golden policy: double-review; adjudicate if disagreement >= 15%; escalate owner if >= 25%. Slots reserved starting 08:30 UTC.
devon: can someone wire a lightweight smoke harness to run crit-rate, BLEURT, tokenizer_delta, and entity-preserve side-by-side vs omega2b-fp16 and omega2b-int8? need per-locale breakdown + token-boundary failure examples.
eval-bot: will queue smoke job; snippet:
```
./eval/run --models omega2b-fp16,omega2b-int8,omega2b-int4 --dataset s3://curation/omega2b/compact-2025/micro-golden.json --metrics crit_rate,bleurt,tokenizer_delta,entity_preserve --out s3://evals/omega2b/bringup-compact
```
otto: add quant-bias checks (name replacement, numeric mangling) and a small anchor set (120) for calibration. anchors must be excluded from golden/review pools.
frida: good. i'll prepare adjudication rubric (clarity, format-preserve, factuality) and post link once ready.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2025-09-14T05:00:00Z -> omega2b-int4 staging-pool. Notifying #eng-runtime.
yasmin: final checklist: normalized upload, dedupe lists, adversarial seeds flagged, labelops reserved, harness wired, anchors excluded, canary scheduled. proceeding if no blockers. :rocket:
devon: thanks all. will post promptset link after upload and follow up with quick runbook for rollback gates.
